kiel-neustadt-bay-lake-return.title: Kiel · Neustadt Bay and Lake Return
kiel-neustadt-bay-lake-return.slogan: Sea views out, lake roads back, and no fake adventure.
kiel-neustadt-bay-lake-return.story: Sea views out, lake roads back, and no fake adventure. The best part sits around Plön lake road, Eutin gate, Neustadt bay, while the most useful town stop keeps the day practical instead of turning it into a fuel or food hunt. Check the OSM map, Google preview and GPX checkpoint order before departure; they use the same waypoint sequence. Ride it with legal pull-offs, patience through villages and enough daylight to stop without rushing.

scenicChapters.title: Plön lake road → Eutin gate
scenicChapters.narrative: Water arrives beside the road and stays for 53 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go — slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did.

scenicChapters.title: Fort site and civil settlement of Boehming → Fort site of Burgsalach
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 30 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

places-fort-site-of-eining-unterfeld-for.story: A 166 km round trip from Neustadt an der Donau - roughly 2 h 52 in the saddle. On the way it passes Fort site and civil settlement of Kösching, Fort site and civil settlement of Boehming, Fort site of Burgsalach and back through Fort site and civil settlement of Boehming. The line favours views over speed.
